TRIAL IS MAY 7, 2012 AT 11:15AM IN DEPARTMENT 503. LAST DAY FOR HEARING SUMMARY MOTIONS IS APRIL 26, WITH OPPOSITIONS DUE FIVE COURT DAYS BEFORE THE HEARING AND REPLIES DUE TWO COURT DAYS BEFORE THE HEARING. PLAINTIFFS TO MAKE A SETTLEMENT DEMAND ON ALL DEFENDANTS NO LATER THAN APRIL 9, 2012. SETTLEMENT CONFERENCE IN ROOM 603 AT 1:30PM ON APRIL 26, 2012. FACT DISCOVERY CUT-OFF DATE IS APRIL 20, 2012. EXPERT DISCOVERY CUT-OFF DATE IS MAY 4, 2012. NO LATER THAN FEBRUARY 17, 2012, PLAINTIFFS MUST PROVIDE A STATEMENT STATING, AS TO EACH DEFENDANT, THE NAME AND CONTACT INFORMATION OF EACH PERSON WITH KNOWLEDGE OF ANY FACTS SUPPORTING ANY OF PLAINTIFF'S CLAIMS. NO LATER THAN FEBRUARY 17, 2012, DEFENDANTS MUST PROVIDE A STATEMENT STATING THE NAME AND CONTACT INFORMATION OF EACH PERSON WITH KNOWLEDGE OF ANY FACTS SUPPORTING ANY OF DEFENDANT'S AFFIRMATIVE DEFENSES. ANY PERSON NOT IDENTIFIED ON THE STATEMENTS WILL BE BARRED FROM TESTIFYING AT TRIAL OR PRESENTING A DECLARATION ON A SUMMARY MOTION ABSENT GOOD CAUSE SHOWN. THE PARTIES TO MEET AND CONFER REGARDING ANY OTHER SCHEDULING OR OTHER ISSUE WHICH ANY OF THEM WANT TO HAVE INCLUDED IN THE PREFERENCE ORDER. FURTHER CASE MANAGEMENT CONFERENCE ON MARCH 21, 2012 AT 1:30PM. NO NEED FOR ANY PARTY TO FILE ANY CASE MANAGEMENT CONFERENCE STATEMENT. PARTIES MAY APPEAR AT THE CONFERENCE BY TELEPHONE. ORDER SIGNED IN OPEN COURT. JUDGE: TERI L. JACKSON, MATTER NOT REPORTED = (503/TLJ)
